nom: Naked Sundays Clear Glow Face & Body Sun Stick Sunscreen SPF50

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: one in humid climate calls it too greasy for makeup wear, while others say it does not clog pores and is fine even for oily skin.
segments.dry: One reviewer suggests the greasy feel might actually suit very dry skin.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin finds it makes her face oily when used alone, though she still uses it on the body.
segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers with sensitive or easily irritated skin, including one allergic to many sunscreens, report no irritation, no stinging, and good tolerance.
segments.mature: One reviewer describes the formula as looking great on youthful/mature skin but notes it is not suited for wearing under makeup.

concerns.aging: One reviewer using it for brown spots on the hands reports fading after a month, with dermatologist approval; another notes it looks nice on mature skin but is unsuitable to wear under makeup.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports brown spots fading after a month of use with dermatologist confirmation.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer says it does not make her break out and another says it does not clog pores; no other blemish outcomes are reported.
concerns.oiliness: Reports diverge sharply: several say it is non-greasy, breathable and matte-adjacent, while others (especially oily skin in humid climates) describe it as greasy, slick, and hard to layer under makeup.

aspects.libelle: No white cast, goes on clear
Runs out quickly for the price

extraits.texte: Unfortunately it was just as another review said, it's like spreading grease on my face. I already have oily skin and I live in South Florida so (humidity) makes this not a good choice especially with makeup. It does glide on clear.
Unfortunately, it was like applying a bar of grease to my face. It might work if you have very dry skin. It does not have a strong scent. There is also too little product to justify the price.

extraits.titre: Perfect for kids on the go
extraits.texte: This stick is great for kids. It glides on like soft butter and just melts into their skins. All my kids (one as young as 3) now happily apply sunscreen themselves with the stick. They even ask for it because it's so easy and pleasant. Would love a slightly bigger stick so it lasts longer. I personally don't like it on my face as I have combo skin which makes it oily but an excellent product for on the go sunscreen application.

I bought this for my sister who had been advised by her dermatologist to wear sunscreen on her hands because of brown spots..they are already fading after only one month and the dermatologist is happy and so is my sister..I got it because she can carry it everywhere and apply in seconds..this isn't just a beauty brand..this is your skins health..dont get spots and skin cancer..get protected and be gorgeous x

I'm allergic to many sunscreens and have to be very careful about what I use on my face. The clear glow stick is AMAZING! I've been using it everyday for a few weeks and my skin loves it! So happy I have found an Australian brand that I can actually use without needing to pay hundreds. I also love that it goes on clear so I can easily reapply without a mirror and it is small enough to fit in a handbag! 10/10 would recommend to anyone!
I was given this as a gift and it's amazing. I have fair skin and my face has not been sunburnt. I bought 3 more for my daughter's for Christmas. Great product. Thankyou Mandy
Quite thick formula, looks great on youthful skin. Not for under make up.
